solutions.title: Classic recursive / iterative stack
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Classic inorder; recursive or iterative with an explicit stack.

**Why preferred:** Standard template; iterative version proves you understand the call stack.

solutions.title: Recursive inorder with shared array
solutions.notes: Recursive accumulator — close; simplify leaf/edge logic
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Recurse left, push `root.val`, recurse right into a shared `response` array.

**vs recommended:** Right traversal order. Drop the leaf special-case and the `left != right` guard — always: traverse left, visit, traverse right. Also practice the iterative stack form.
